title: Resolve each role to its own route at run time; state what the Consultant may send
goal: Misato and the Consultant call their own route and model; the Consultant on cloud sends only what its rule allows, written in the record and in the code comment
acceptance: Test across config and runtime (models resolved per role, not from one shared cloud model); a failed route reports failure, no automatic fallback

The Consultant on cloud gets the owner question and Misato's plan context only: no tool results marked private or local-only, no memory facts, no Grover data until F-156 lets the owner allow a category
Local-only input still never leaves the machine (areas.md: never fall back to cloud for local-only input)

Prompt caching on every cloud call: the stable prefix (Misato's instructions, tool index, rules) comes first and the volatile parts (time, request, context) after the last cache breakpoint; a test across the request builder and the usage record checks `usage.cache_read_input_tokens` > 0 on a repeated call (cached input costs about a tenth)

The per-model concurrency budget (src/model-budget.ts, default 2) is set per route: local models stay at 1-2, cloud models may run several sorties in parallel (e.g. 4-8), bounded by Anthropic rate limits and the F-156 budget; separate budgets let a cloud Consultant run alongside a local Misato (tested)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
